abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn: look at the top 2 cards of your deck, put 1 into your hand and the other on the bottom.

cards.name: Dragapult ex
cards.text: Tera: while on your Bench, prevent all damage done to it by attacks.

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.text: Then place 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon however you like.

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if it has Darkness Energy attached: move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: The opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play Item cards.

attacks.name: Trading Places
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Run Away Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn: draw 3 cards. If you drew any, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Tenacious Tail
attacks.text: 60 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon ex in play.

attacks.name: Destructive Drill
attacks.text: Not affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Last-Ditch Catch
abilities.text: When you play it from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter and put it into your hand. Only 1 'Last-Ditch' Ability per turn.

attacks.name: Tuck Tail
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

abilities.name: Flip the Script
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn: draw 3 cards. Only 1 Flip the Script per turn.

attacks.name: Cruel Arrow
attacks.text: 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon (no Weakness/Resistance on the Bench).

abilities.name: Trade
abilities.text: Once during your turn: discard a card from your hand to draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Night Joker
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: Not affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rampaging Thunder
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Powerful Rage
attacks.text: 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Subjugating Chains
abilities.text: Once during your turn: switch 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon (not Pecharunt ex) with your Active Pokémon; the new Active is Poisoned. Only 1 Subjugating Chains per turn.

attacks.name: Irritated Outburst
attacks.text: 60 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.name: Lillie's Determination
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards (8 if you have exactly 6 Prize cards left).

cards.name: Boss's Orders
cards.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Crispin
cards.text: Search for up to 2 Basic Energy of different types: put 1 into your hand and attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle.

cards.name: Rosa's Encouragement
cards.text: Only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent: attach up to 2 Basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

cards.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
cards.text: Put up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your deck onto your Bench. Shuffle.

cards.name: Crushing Hammer
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Pad
cards.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon without a Rule Box and put it into your hand. Shuffle.

cards.name: Night Stretcher
cards.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Ultra Ball
cards.text: Discard 2 other cards from your hand to search your deck for a Pokémon and put it into your hand. Shuffle.

cards.name: Special Red Card
cards.text: Only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards left: they put their hand on the bottom of their deck, then draw 3 if they put any there.

cards.name: Unfair Stamp
cards.text: ACE SPEC. Only if one of your Pokémon was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn: both players shuffle their hands into their decks; you draw 5, they draw 2.

cards.name: Risky Ruins
cards.text: Whenever a player puts a Basic non-Darkness Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on it.

cards.name: Black Belt's Training
cards.text: This turn, your attacks do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Cyrano
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon ex and put them into your hand. Shuffle.

cards.name: Judge
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

cards.name: N's PP Up
cards.text: Attach a Basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon.

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.text: If the Darkness Pokémon holding this is Active and damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Knocked Out), put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: N's Castle
cards.text: N's Pokémon in play (both players') have no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
cards.text: Colorless Pokémon in play (both players') have no Abilities.
